Luckily, the Geeks are on Our Side The bad guys have been getting bolder. It’s a good thing the really smart cyber-nerds are on our side. Built by a team of security researchers with a lifelong devotion to cyber, novoShield’s technology is based on decades of cyber intelligence experience, along with deep research into tens of thousands of real-life security breaches. Designed to defend against a new era of digital threats, novoShield is the only mobile security solution suited for individuals and businesses alike. Security or Simplicity? Why Not Both! Security used to come with a price. Experts were needed to install and configure cumbersome solutions. Lags in device performance or battery life were common, written off as the cost of staying safe. VPNs offered online security, but blocked access to important services and slowed networks to a frustrating crawl. No longer. novoShield’s unique approach to cybersecurity offers a lightweight and easy-to-use solution that keeps you and your data secure with no lag in battery life or processing power. Now you really can have it all: performance and protection. Real-Time Security from Real-World Threats novoShield’s proprietary behavioral engine offers a new approach to personal cybersecurity that doesn’t rely on already-identified threats. Instead, our dynamic phishing detection engine is trained to identify thousands of markers of malicious websites, computing a threat assessment score that determines site accessibility. With new phishing webpages deployed every minute and personalized to their targets, your security demands immediate, multi-layered flexibility. novoShield’s research-driven technology deploys real-time threat detection, so you can stay protected from threats waged just moments ago, and never seen before. Total Privacy. Even from Us. We believe that your data belongs to you alone. Our threat detection and containment systems keep you safe without compromising a byte of your privacy. We’re not interested in the details of your data. Only in its defense. For Every Tap on Every App “Our browser-based technology protects a wide range of apps on your device, such as SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, QR codes, email, social media, web browsing and more. No matter where you come across a link, novoShield will protect you from any phishing threats that lurk behind them on the web, before they have a chance to inflict damage or steal your data. jobs.description: About - novoShield | Protect your PRIVACY About Technology Business Individuals Blog FAQ Contact Us Business Login About Technology novoShield for Business novoshield for Individuals Blog FAQ Contact Us Business Login DOWNLOAD NOVOSHIELD About Us novoShield brings industry-leading cyber security to your mobile devices, so you can work, play, and connect - fearlessly. Follow us on social media: Our Story At the Frontlines of Cyber-Operations Our founders met serving in the digital trenches of the world’s most elite cyber-military units. From those frontlines, they witnessed the brutal strength of technology. After developing world-changing code to defend national interests and safeguard international infrastructures, they decided to channel their expertise to protect everyday users across the globe. From InfoSec to iPhone Deeper research revealed the average user’s greatest digital vulnerability – their mobile devices. Our phones are entrusted with every detail of our lives and businesses, but are outfitted only the most rudimentary protection. We spend our days swiping, tapping, and sharing with little awareness of the constant threats poised at our fingertips. Introducing novoShield And so novoShield was founded with a simple mission: to protect everyone, everywhere with the world’s most innovative and effective mobile cybersecurity. novoShield leverages decades of experience at the cutting-edge of cyberwarfare to protect users from one of the world’s most troubling and rapidly evolving security threats: phishing. Effortless Security for Everyone novoShield is guided by the belief that protection should be easy to manage and available to everyone – not just enterprise corporations. That’s why we built a new layer of advanced digital security so affordable that it’s within reach of every user, and so accessible that you can download it from the App Store. Meet the Team Our team doesn’t wear capes and only occasionally puts their underwear on over their tights, but they are superheroes nonetheless. From the front lines of cyber intelligence to the forefront of mobile technology, the novoShield team is united in its commitment to security for all.
